decision_contract.notice_check_allowed: Metadata supports acquiring the official text file only to verify its internal notice, edition, credits, and contributors. This is not a public-domain declaration or admission of prose.
decision_contract.hold_term_likely_active: Available author and publication evidence indicates that Japanese protection may still subsist. Do not acquire or inspect the ebook for this frame.
decision_contract.hold_identity_or_death_unverified: Neither a named-author death calculation nor a verified anonymous or pseudonymous publication-term calculation is supported well enough. Do not acquire or inspect the ebook for this frame.

japan_rules_applied: Terms run from January 1 of the year after death, publication, or creation as applicable.
The ordinary term changed from 50 to 70 years on 2018-12-30, without reviving an already expired term.
Anonymous or pseudonymous prose normally follows a publication-based term unless an author-identity exception applies.
A pre-1971 work requires the old-law transition as well as later death- or publication-term rules.
A term still running on 2018-12-29 because of wartime addition receives the extension; the United States addition is 3,794 days.
method.pseudonym_rule: Use publication time only when evidence establishes anonymous or pseudonymous publication and no author-identity exception controls. When a plausible true-author attribution is available, require that the named-author route also be expired; an unexplained name is not assumed to be a pseudonym.
method.text_only_scope: Images, cover art, ornamental art, image-only credits, and illustration-specific captions or alt text are excluded; retained contributor-authored prose must be reviewed after acquisition.
method.content_blindness: Decisions use creator identity, publication evidence, and legal term only; title topic, sensitivity, lexical yield, MWE presence, and sense distribution do not affect a row.
method.futility_rule: At rank 40, stop before further acquisition when prior mechanical passes plus every remaining rights-eligible file cannot reach ten in either stratum.

incidental_search_exposure.description: Rights-oriented Web results exposed automated summaries, title matter, first-edition facsimile text, or body snippets for these already frozen rows. No query contained an MWE or target form, and no exposure affected order, rights decisions, or the futility calculation.

claim_limits: No row is declared public domain worldwide or admitted to the study.
United States and Japanese metadata triage does not authorize global Web serving; source prose remains local and unbundled.
The final rights screen proves only that the frozen two-stratum stop cannot be reached; it does not estimate MWE prevalence, coverage, audience suitability, or representativeness.
The adult stratum's maximum of eight assumes every remaining rights-eligible file would pass the mechanical unit gate and is therefore an intentionally generous upper bound.
Rights-search exposure means the named rows are not fully unseen for later lexical review, although fixed order and the futility proof remain outcome-blind.
Illustrator exclusion cannot erase contributor-authored prose, notes, captions, or edition-specific material discovered in a future redesigned frame.
next_action: Stop the frozen Gutenberg frame before acquiring batch-4 ebooks: the adult stratum can reach at most eight mechanical passes. Preserve the failed frame unchanged and freeze a redesigned open-material sampling rule before any new acquisition or MWE inspection.
